title: M1: Embedded execution and deployment-owned classifier persistence
description:
PLANNING ONLY. Ryan requested filing and design before implementation. This issue is not authorization to build runtime features, deploy, change cloud permissions, publish packages, push, or migrate production data. Keep open pending design review and separate implementation authorization.

Future milestone: operate the same Cyclotron contract in a Papyrus deployment with all classifier data under that deployment ownership. No separate lab, no external Cyclotron store or hidden remote dependency. Reuse existing portable store/snapshot/lease work where compatible; do not assume a new store backend or a cloud permission change.

Future Definition of Done: decide, human review and learning work locally; restart/retry preserve historical labels and versions without duplicate learning; concurrent-writer and durability behavior are explicit. Storage adapter/lifecycle for scale-to-zero and failure recovery remain open design questions.

Preserve optional curated-example priming (decision-flywheel-da886c09-7acb-45d3-acf8-c81585f26d8a), its preview/revision/explicit-label acceptance contract, and separate existing scholarly research-paper and web-summary transformations. Priming must never become an onboarding gate. Common input items are distinct from publication-specific decisions; one publication accepting an item must never implicitly label another output.
